known_limits: An LLM agent: wording and sometimes the data path differ between runs. During the iterations, about one run in five or ten failed for the period and company-level questions; the last version passed every check above, but this is a small sample.
The previous question can still influence the next one in some runs; clear the chat when changing the topic.
Priority tiers in Q4 are the agent's own judgement and vary (the two C09 contracts are 低 in some runs and 中 in others).
